title: Pass0bResult
description: Pass 0b: Step-level somatic feature extraction with three-tier architecture

steps.description: Enriched steps, one per input step, in order

step_number.description: Step number matching the input step

group_number.description: Group number this step belongs to

mechanical_directive.description: The explicit physical command. If no physical action, write 'None — [label]'.

quality_constraint.description: Literal somatic language directing attention to how the student moves — cues for internal sensation, effort regulation, bodily awareness. Write 'None' if absent.

sensory_inquiry.description: What the student is asked to feel or notice, especially in non-moving parts. Extract literally from original segment texts.

clarified.description: Clear rewrite of the full somatic event with all ambiguous references resolved

differentiation.description: What body parts or movements are being distinguished from each other. Anatomical language. Write 'None' if absent.

activation.description: What muscles, chains, or skeletal structures are being recruited or engaged. Anatomical language. Write 'None' for rest/attentional steps.

inhibition.description: What must release or stay quiet to allow transmission. Write 'None' if not applicable.

transmission_route.description: Skeletal path of force/movement using arrow notation (e.g. 'foot → femur → pelvis → spine'). Write 'None' if no clear path.

ground_push.description: Where the body presses into the floor to generate ground reaction force supporting this movement. Write 'None' if not applicable.

relevance.description: true if the step is part of the lesson content, false if it is off-topic noise (technical issues, mute/unmute, admin chatter)

intent.description: Pedagogical purpose: the learning strategy behind this step
